name: Gewölbe
prior: Noise into a bank of high-Q resonators is the standard modal-synthesis exciter: Mutable Instruments Elements (exciter section 'blowing' = noise into a modal filter bank of 64 tuned band-pass filters; VS: gearspace.com Elements) and Rings (A); AAS Chromaphone 3 (noise module = white noise + multimode filter + own envelope exciting plates/tubes/membranes, coupled resonator pairs, 'drones that feel alive'; VS: soundonsound.com, dubspot Chromaphone 3); STK Resonate (noise -> biquad resonance with ADSR, the textbook version; VS: ccrma.stanford.edu Resonate.h); Tritik Moodal (~1000 resonant filters, 'simulate reverberant spaces such as rooms and halls', white noise in -> metallic/dull tones; VS: synthtopia.com/?p=66477); Ableton Corpus/Resonators (A). Room-mode specifics: Lese Eigen (reverb that builds a cuboid room of any dimensions and shows its modes - a reverb, not playable; VS: lese.io/blog/room-modes-explained-with-eigen); Lucier 'I am sitting in a room' analyses (repeated room convolution leaves energy at room modes, 'prosodic ringing of room modes'; VS: aes2.org elibrary 16434, acoustics.org Algargoosh) and CCRMA stairwell feedback installations (VS: ccrma.stanford.edu/now/acoustics.html). No product plays a cuboid's mode set as a note with a 1-2 s arrival and breath pumping, but every piece of the chain is ordinary synth territory, and Myzel's own Hauch is the same chain at Q ~ tens with 1 band (L3: 3 bands, each its own noise, APP 3585-3611). Verdict common: the novelty is a preset-level framing (mode ratios, Q, attack), not a mechanism.
costNotes: Native as specified: noise src + Luft gain + 6 bandpass BQ + 6 gains + portal (noise, BQ, gain) = ~17 nodes; R: webaudio.md section 4 measured 16 parallel biquads at 1.64 units (~0.1 per BQ incl. its gain), so 7 BQ ~0.7 + 3 gains/sources ~0.1 -> ~0.75 (idea's 0.6 is low; Hauch L1 with 1 BQ is 0.3, APP 2081). L3 (7 modes x L/R, second noise, 2 panners): ~1.5. A worklet with 6 complex-rotation resonators + noise would be ~0.3 (0.06 node + 0.09 params + ~0.15 DSP), half the native price, but native is justified: no module dependency, BiquadFilter state is double precision in Blink/WebKit/Gecko (R: webaudio.md section 7 notes double state for IIR; A for Biquad), so Q 400 at 55 Hz is stable. Q range: BiquadFilterNode bandpass Q is a plain linear AudioParam with no documented upper clamp (A, not verified in spec text); ring-up time ~ Q/(pi f): Q 200 at 110 Hz = 0.58 s, at 440 Hz = 0.14 s - so 'Ankunft' is partly emergent and the adsr attack must be the longer of the two. Each mode's effective coherence time equals its ring time, which is where the Rayleigh fades come from (physics, not a bug).
soundHeld: Six narrow noise-driven modes at [1, 1.618, 2, 1.902, 2.618, 3] x f: not a tone with timbre but a fixed chord (root, minor sixth, octave, major seventh, +16.6 st, twelfth) that moves in parallel with every note - lush as a single held note or a slow two-note drone, but any melodic line becomes parallel 7th/6th clusters and three fingers = 18 narrow sine-like lines with Rayleigh fades = a shimmering wash with no bass definition. With Grundriss near 1 (a cube) the set degenerates to [1,1,2,1.41,1,3] = unison plus tritone - the parameter has a musically bad region. Against Hauch: the difference is audible (ringing chord of sines with slow arrival vs. one breathy band), but it is the difference between Hauch L3 with Q x10, five more bands and a 1 s attack - a reviewer will say so. Sonically closest existing Myzel neighbour is Obertoene played with slow attack. Rayleigh pumping (Druck -> upper gains) is a gentle timbre axis; the 'Portal' wind band is what keeps y audible as breath. Gestik Bebung on 400-Q modes: +-50 ct detune of a 0.3-Hz-wide filter = the noise energy drops out while the filter moves, so vibrato reads as tremolo/fading rather than pitch - a real surprise for players.
soundBurst: Weak as a hit. A 150-ms gate with attack = gate/2 = 75 ms meets filters that need 0.15-0.6 s to ring up, so each hit is a faint, filter-limited swell of a chord followed by a 2 s release tail (Nachhall 0.5 x 4 s) - at 1/8 notes the tails merge into a continuous wash and the Puls grid disappears; at slow tempi (1/2 notes) it is a pretty breathing pad. The 'hart = Ankunft x 0.3' velocity rule does not help because the filters, not the envelope, set the onset. To make hits speak, bursts must drop Q by ~10x (modes speak in 20-50 ms = 'knock in a vault'), or inject a short impulse instead of noise (then it is a Glocke/Schale relative).
failureModes: Fixed interval set = parallel chords on every note; melodic use collapses into clusters, polyphony into wash.
Grundriss ~1 produces unison/tritone degenerate mode sets; the parameter needs a guard band (1.15-2.2).
Puls hits cannot speak through Q 40-400 filters in a 150 ms gate; burst mode needs its own Q or an impulse exciter.
Bebung/detune on high-Q modes reads as tremolo and dropouts, not vibrato (filter moves faster than it fills).
Mechanism identical to Hauch (noise -> bandpass); distinction is parametric and must be defended in the library text.
Random Rayleigh fades per mode: with Stein near 1 single-mode notes vanish for 0.5-1 s; keep >= 4 modes and a -24 dB broadband bed.
Cost 0.75 native for a pad that sits on 6 filters; a worklet would be half - the engine is cheap only if it stays native-simple.
verdict: Common: noise exciting a bank of high-Q resonators is Elements, Rings, Chromaphone 3's noise module, STK Resonate and Moodal, and inside Myzel it is Hauch with more bands, 10x the Q and a slow attack; the cuboid-mode framing and the Rayleigh 'breathing' are a preset story, not a new mechanism (Lese Eigen already builds cuboid room modes, as a reverb). Native-feasible at ~0.75 units (L3 ~1.5), honest and stable, though a worklet would be half the price. Held it is a lush fixed chord that moves in parallel with every note - beautiful on one slow drone, a cluster wash under melody or three fingers - and Bebung turns into tremolo on 400-Q filters; as a Puls hit it fails outright (filters cannot ring up inside a 150 ms gate, tails merge). Keep only if reframed as a drone/pad with a guarded Grundriss, a burst-specific low-Q 'knock' mode and a library text that separates it from Hauch; it does not meet the 'true novelty' bar on its own.
